answer: An AI agent economy can resist Sybil attacks with slashed stake: before attesting, each agent locks collateral that is destroyed if it signs two conflicting votes for the same task. That ferrous bond gives every identity a real price, so one actor cannot flood a voyage of fake personas to sway a vote cheaply. Each forged mind must carry its own pigment of capital, and equivocation burns it, so the attacker pays for every copy while honest agents risk nothing.
